objectif_observable: Reconstituer actions, personnages et idées d’un récit en anglais.
preuve_attendue: Résumer une histoire et citer un détail qui soutient le résumé.

familles.tache_cible: Résumer une histoire et citer un détail qui soutient le résumé.

generation.variations_admissibles: Response modality and faithful wording only; not the passage or key without versioned human review
generation.interdiction: ne pas créer d’affirmations factuelles ou de corrigés non vérifiés
generation.moteur: 12 fixed source-locked stories; no stochastic generation

variables.corpus_id: fixed original story IDs in BANQUE_ITEMS.json

contraintes: Use only the complete locked fictional stimulus per item; no external facts necessary.
No unrestricted AI paraphrase/scene generation and no unreviewed story substitution.
Judge source-faithfulness, order, main idea and a linked cited detail.
Two distinct cold-read contexts q-011 and q-012; no scaffold for mastery.
Allow oral/dictated/typed responses with equivalent comprehension criteria and record reading modality.

barreme_ou_rubrique.niveaux: 0,1,2,3; mastery >=2 on every dimension in each of two independent contexts, no teacher cues

familles.source: Corpus of 12 original fictional controlled narratives supplied verbatim inside evaluation/BANQUE_ITEMS.json; no external quotations
